remarks: Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Tokeneke School District, this charming 3-bedroom Colonial offers a perfect blend of classic style and modern comfort. Set on nearly an acre of beautifully landscaped grounds, the home features a private, picturesque back patio oasis-ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying nature year-round.  Taken down to the studs in 2004, 6 Queens Lane feels fresh and new. Inside, a stunningly renovated kitchen opens seamlessly to the dining room and living room, creating a warm, inviting space for everyday living and special gatherings. There is also spacious family room with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light-perfect for cozy movie nights or entertaining.  The thoughtfully designed main floor includes a luxurious primary bedroom suite, offering convenience and privacy with an en-suite bath and generous closet space. Upstairs, you'll find two large bedrooms, a full bath, and a home office-ideal for remote work or homework stations.  This home combines comfort, space, and functionality in an idyllic setting, just minutes from schools, shops, and commuting options. A rare opportunity to own a turnkey property in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods.
